name: Convergence Table
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity north-star composition for a desktop product/docs homepage
Primary request: Design the full first 1.6 viewports of the Agent Factory homepage in the locked Drawcord System visual world. Composition C: Convergence Table. A compact navigation leads to a forceful proposition and install command at upper left. Most of the first viewport is one wide technical routing table where three host cords enter from the left, split into bounded specialist channels, pass through human gates and verification loops, then gather into one Ready Change anchor at far right. Below, a quieter section contrasts Shape Work and Do Work as separate routes with starter commands. The diagram is the hero and must prove the mechanism immediately.
Real content: Agent Factory; From work item to ready change.; Install Agent Factory; Codex; Claude Code; OpenCode; Shape work; Do work; Human gate; Ready change. Do not invent testimonials, metrics, customers, prices, or capabilities.
Visual system: near-black silk #121317, muted drawcord gold #B79A55, graphite/slate #4A4E57, warm chalk #E5E0D4. Narrow tailored grotesk for labels; readable workhorse sans for body. Gold routing cords, graphite stitching, gathered matte folds, anchor and lock controls.
Composition/framing: straight-on 1536x1024 desktop webpage, no browser chrome; high-fidelity web UI comp. The wide route table uses roughly 65 percent of the first viewport and reads left to right. Show enough second fold to prove the system.
Avoid generic AI motifs, robots, brains, chat bubbles, neon, purple, gradients, glassmorphism, glowing nodes, bento grids, literal cape photography, model imagery, and watermarks.
